user.title: Share your solar production on the Kilowattlas map
user.description:
Kilowattlas is a free, public, live map of solar production built from readings shared by homes like yours. This integration is open source and sends only what is listed here.

**What is sent and shown**

- Your Home Assistant home position is sent once, as a suggestion for where the installation is. You confirm or adjust it on the website before anything is shown.
- The installation's position, capacity and live production are shown publicly on kilowattlas.com, without your name, account or e-mail.
- Every reading from the power sensor you choose is sent as your sensor reports it. Nothing else from Home Assistant is sent.

**What the data is used for**

- The public map and your own production history.
- Comparing how your installation performs against similar installations.

Any other use of your data, for example fault alerts through a service partner or aggregated data for electricity-market forecasting, will be a separate choice you make on the website. It is never switched on by this integration.

You can stop at any time: remove this integration, then delete the installation on kilowattlas.com to erase its history.
